Tables (from January-March 1994 to April-June 2026)

Ⅰ. GDP (Expenditure Approach) and Its Components

  1. Due to the revisions to source statistics etc., estimates of nominal original series from January-March 2024 and estimates of real original series from January-March 2023 may be revised from previous release.
  2. As seasonal adjustment is conducted with the latest estimates of original series every release, all estimates of both nominal and real seasonally adjusted series from January-March 1994 are revised from previous release. To download the latest estimates for any period, always the latest release should be consulted.
Note: Files are in CSV format.

Ⅱ.Domestic Final Consumption Expenditure of Households Classified by Type, Gross Fixed Capital Formation Classified by Type, and Exports and Imports of Goods and Services

  1. Domestic Final Consumption Expenditure of Households Classified by Type disaggregates Domestic Final Consumption Expenditure of Households into four categories (Durable Goods, Semi-Durable Goods, Non-Durable Goods and Services) by classifying each item of the classification of goods and services by 116 purposes in the estimation process of Domestic Final Consumption Expenditure of Households into the four categories of Domestic Final Consumption Expenditure of Households Classified by Type.

  2. Gross Fixed Capital Formation Classified by Type disaggregates Gross Fixed Capital Formation in Ⅰ. GDP (Expenditure Approach) and Its Components into five categories with supply-side source statistics etc. It should be noted that the estimates of Gross Fixed Capital Formation Classified by Type in Quarterly Estimates of GDP (Second Preliminary Estimates) disaggregate the total (estimates after adjusting the deduction of consumption tax) based on the quarterly share of each type (estimates before adjusting the deduction), since it is difficult to estimate the amount of the deduction because of data limitation.

  • (*) Correspondence between classification of goods and services by 116 purposes and four categories of Domestic Final Consumption of Expenditure of Households (PDF:46KB)

Ⅲ.Compensation of Employees

  1. As seasonal adjustment is conducted with the latest estimates of original series every release, all estimates of both nominal and real seasonally adjusted series from January-March 1994 are revised from previous release. To download the latest estimates for any period, always the latest release should be consulted.

  2. Level of seasonally adjusted series is annualized.

  3. Real compensation of employees (reference series) uses Consumption of households (excluding imputed rent and FISIM) deflator and Consumption of households deflator .
